title: Which Past Matters? Training History and Multi-Forecast Horizon in Equity Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.23126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: More historical data can improve estimation while introducing relationships that transfer poorly to current market conditions. We therefore examine how training quantity and historical selection interact with forecast horizon in intraday equity prediction. We deploy twelve configurations which combine four sampling and validation policies with 6, 12 and 24 month training quantities under a fixed cross-sectional Transformer and feature set. A monthly walk-forward experiment produces 264 refits and eight cumulative return forecasts from 5 to 120 minutes. Evaluation covers January 2025 through 20 October 2026 and uses cross-sectional Spearman information coefficients against future five-factor residual returns. Six-month recency sampling leads individual models at 5-15 minutes, while multi recency configurations lead at 20-30 minutes and uniform configurations at 60-120 minutes. translated_title: 哪段历史最重要？股票Transformer模型中的训练历史与多预测期限
translated_abstract: 更多的历史数据可以改善估计效果，但同时也会引入难以迁移到当前市场状况的关系。因此，我们研究了训练数据量与历史数据选择如何与日内股票预测中的预测期限相互作用。我们部署了十二种配置，将四种采样与验证策略同6个月、12个月和24个月的训练数据量相结合，并采用固定的横截面Transformer架构与特征集。月度滚动前推实验共产生了264次重新拟合，以及从5分钟到120分钟的八个累计收益预测。评估区间覆盖2025年1月至2026年10月20日，并使用横截面Spearman信息系数，以未来五因子残差收益作为评估基准。结果显示，6个月近期数据采样在5-15分钟的单模型预测期限中表现领先，而多近期数据配置在20-30分钟期限领先，均匀采样配置则在60-120分钟期限领先。增加训练数据量并不能一致地提升预测准确率。
tldr: 本文通过十二种配置的月度滚动实验发现，在日内股票收益预测中，最优的历史训练数据选择取决于预测期限——短期预测（5-15分钟）适合近期数据采样，长期预测（60-120分钟）适合均匀采样，且单纯增加训练数据量并不能持续提升预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper's twelve-configuration walk-forward experiment shows that the optimal training history selection for intraday equity Transformer prediction depends on the forecast horizon—recency sampling wins at 5-15 minutes while uniform sampling wins at 60-120 minutes—and that simply increasing training quantity does not uniformly improve accuracy.
